raw:
Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 3
Reason for Mistake: The Planner misidentified Princess Margaretha of Saxony’s mother, incorrectly asserting it was Archduchess Luise of Austria-Tuscany despite the initial search result showing her mother as Princess Amalie Auguste of Bavaria. This confusion arose from conflating two different Princesses Margaretha/Margarete of Saxony (the 1840 princess vs. the 1900 princess). As a result, subsequent steps researched the wrong mother’s birthplace (Salzburg) instead of the correct one (Munich).
